extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: The largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions, covering four primary categories: concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors collected 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet across various subjects (men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases) and used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to generate paired videos by matching each image to compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, User-generated content data, Software Collection, Others
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images collected from the Internet, Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling), and community LoRAs from Civitai.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are resized to 480 × 720 (832) and sampled at 49 frames at 16 fps, then encoded into latents using a video VAE encoder.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Pairing of reference images to compatible visual effects templates and LoRAs to synthesize semantic-controlled videos. Captions are standard video descriptions describing the content and semantic attributes.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: VIDU, Kling, Civitai LoRAs, Gemini-2.5-pro, GPT-5
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images of men, women, and children depicting human faces, bodies, and personal visual characteristics.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuse risks include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigation includes a research-only license, acceptable-use policy (AUP), and content filters blocking harmful categories.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may cause the dataset to inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., poor hand generation).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Semantic conditions are synthetic and derived from other generative models; performance can degrade when semantic descriptions diverge or large subject mismatch occurs; multi-reference inputs may lead to appearance leakage.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating unified semantic-controlled video generation models (concept, style, motion, and camera control) and downstream video generation/editing applications under a research-only license.
